note: Smart Title UI is a trivial admin submodule: one settings form at /admin/config/content/smart-title (route smart_title_ui.settings, permission 'administer smart title') that writes the eligible bundle list into the parent module's smart_title.settings.smart_title ('entity_type:bundle' strings). It stores no config of its own. The medium case reuses the parent's eligible-bundle config; the hard case writes node:article into smart_title.settings as the form would, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: What is the route name and admin path of the Smart Title settings page provided by smart_title_ui?
evals.expected_output: Route smart_title_ui.settings at path /admin/config/content/smart-title (title 'Smart Title Settings').

evals.prompt: Which permission gates the Smart Title UI settings form?
evals.expected_output: The 'administer smart title' permission ('Manage Smart Title configuration').

evals.prompt: When you submit the Smart Title UI settings form, what configuration does it change?
evals.expected_output: It writes the checked bundles as '<entity_type>:<bundle>' strings into smart_title.settings.smart_title (the parent module's config), unsets Smart Title third-party settings on displays of any unchecked bundle, and invalidates the entity_field_info cache. It stores no config of its own.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which bundles has the Smart Title UI made eligible for Smart Title? Inspect the live configuration and list them.
evals.expected_output: smart_title.settings.smart_title (managed by the Smart Title UI form) lists node:article and node:page.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use Smart Title (via its UI submodule's settings) to make the Article content type eligible for Smart Title. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add 'node:article' to smart_title.settings.smart_title (what submitting the /admin/config/content/smart-title form with Article checked does).
